title: Inyandiko zanjye
intro: Resept, ibyemezo by'uburwayi, amabaruwa yohereza n'ibizamini byasabwe mu ngendo zawe. Buri imwe ifite kode umuntu wese ashobora kugenzura.
emptyBody: Muganga nasinya resept, urwandiko cyangwa icyemezo cy'uburwayi, kizagaragara hano.
codeHint: Iri munsi ya kode ya QR ku rupapuro. Nimero {{number}}.
newVersion: Iyi ni verisiyo ya {{n}}. Izacapwe mbere ntizikigezweho.

share.title: Sangiza undi muntu
share.intro: Kora ihuza ry'umukoresha, ishuri cyangwa undi muganga. Rifungura iyi nyandiko yonyine kandi rihagarara iyo igihe cyaryo kirangiye.

verify.title: Genzura inyandiko
verify.intro: Andika kode iri munsi ya QR code.
verify.notFoundBody: Ongera urebe kode. Inyandiko itabonetse ishobora kuba ari impimbano.
verify.limited: Wagenzuye kenshi. Tegereza umunota umwe wongere ugerageze.
verify.author: Byasinywe na
verify.version: Verisiyo ya {{n}}: indi nshya yasimbuye iyacapwe bwa mbere.
verify.detailsIntro: Kugira ngo urebe ibiyirimo, andika itariki y'amavuko y'umurwayi.
verify.dobMismatch: Iyo tariki y'amavuko ntihuye n'iyi nyandiko.

shared.title: Inyandiko yasangijwe
shared.goneBody: Igihe cyaryo cyarangiye cyangwa umurwayi yarihagaritse. Musabe irindi huza.
